files.notes: Full port: IPythonCellComponent with header/status rows, output/diff/sent-message rendering, traceback splitting, ctrl+o / ctrl+j hint rows, image placeholder, spinner and tool-result state. All 33 TS members have a Rust counterpart ({startOutput} is inlined as the repeated `if !output_started` guard, exactly matching the TS closure semantics). 20 #[test]s.
Full port: MenuPanelComponent with item list, meta column, gap/padding, primary/secondary colors, selection marker and the scroll window helpers. 5 #[test]s.

Full port: AssistantMessageComponent with markdown rendering, thinking/tool-call rows, quiet-mode styling and the collapsed/expanded body. `quiet` was turned from a local closure into a private `fn quiet` (borrow fix). Uses a private `to_tui_markdown_theme`/`clone_tui_markdown_theme` pair because pi-tui's MarkdownTheme is not Clone. 11 #[test]s.

PARTIAL: CustomEditorOptions + CustomEditor with command-token highlighting (prompt_highlight::ArgTokenHighlighter), placeholder/header content lines, onAction handlers, escape/ctrl+d/tab hooks and background padding are ported. What is NOT portable: the TS overrides the protected pi-tui Editor hooks (getPromptPrefix, formatPromptPrefix, getHiddenTextPrefixLength, styleDisplayText) and reads getAutocompleteAnchorMarker(); those are private in pi-tui, so the wrapper re-implements only the observable behaviours and the placeholder row omits the zero-width autocomplete marker. 9 #[test]s.
Full port: BashExecutionComponent with spinner, running/finished/error states, exit-code and duration rows, truncation and the DynamicBorder chrome. 9 #[test]s.
Full port: the context-tree formatting helpers (tree walking, connector glyphs, node labels, token/percent columns, truncation). The recursive TS closure is a private `fn walk`. 6 #[test]s.
Full port: ExtensionSelectorComponent (SelectList + DynamicBorder, countdown wiring, cancel/timeout handling, key hints). 4 #[test]s.
Full port: EditSummaryComponent with per-file rows, +/- counts, rich diff rendering (diff::render_rich_diff), indentation and truncation. 9 #[test]s.
Full port: AgentMessageComponent rendering participant/direction headers via format_agent_message_participant plus body styling. 6 #[test]s.
Full port: ExtensionInputComponent (prompt header, Input field, submit/cancel wiring, countdown drain in render). 3 #[test]s.
Full port: ThemeSelectorComponent over SelectList with a private `to_tui_select_list_theme` converter (pi-tui theme types are not shared). 0 dedicated #[test]s (covered indirectly).
Full port: BranchSummaryMessageComponent with markdown body and the same markdown-theme bridge as assistant_message.rs. 3 #[test]s.
Full port: FeatureHintComponent with padded hint line plus blank line; the TS `constructor` maps to `new`. 2 #[test]s.

PARTIAL (deliberate, documented): CountdownTimer keeps remaining_seconds/disposed in shared atomics and runs the setInterval equivalent as a tokio interval task that posts ticks on an mpsc channel; the owner drains the channel in `poll()`, which must be called from `render()` (extension_input.rs and extension_selector.rs do this). This preserves the TS call order (tick -> requestRender -> expire/dispose) and keeps the non-Send callbacks on the owner thread, but callers must poll - a behaviour difference from the JS timer. 3 #[test]s.
Full port: CompactionOutcomeMessageComponent with the outcome rows and DynamicBorder chrome. 2 #[test]s.
